details: Seems like this started happening with the recent patch that attempted to fix Avatar 3.0 avatars with regards to sitting animations. This seems to happen when an avatar with Avatar 3.0 tries to sit on the station of an avatar with SDK2 and a custom sitting animation. Most if not everyone in the world will crash and the instance itself seems to break entirely, as no one can join after that happens.
title: Avatars on SDK 3.0 can crash a world by sitting on another avatar's chair with SDK2 and custom animations.
